text:
Alex Tan: Hey all — first week here! SSO works but when I click into the admin panel / feature-flag UI I get a 403. Also trying to provision an SSH key for the infra toolchain and need KMS access to demo a private deployment. Who do I ask for the provisioning steps?
Devon H.: welcome Alex :wave: Quick checklist — 1) SSH pubkey in the infra portal, 2) request KMS role via support, 3) confirm you’re on the right team mapping. Which workspace/org are you in?
Alex Tan: thanks — team is `platform-infra` and I'm on staging only for now.
Samira K.: @Devon H. you can add them to the staging-ops team mapping. Alex, easiest path: paste your `id_rsa.pub` in the portal under "SSH keys" or run `ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C \"alex@redwood.ai\"` then paste.
Alex Tan: got it — where's the portal? I tried the Console URL but landed on SSO.
Devon H.: internal link: https://internal.redwood/tools/infra-portal (requires SSO + team mapping). If 403 after SSO, that usually means your org tag isn't attached.
InfraBot: New access request templates: `#access-requests` -> choose "KMS (staging)" or "SSH key add". Expected turnaround: 1 business day for staging.
Jules: For KMS, please include the key usage reason and the demo timeframe in the request. Ops will provision a role-scoped key, not full admin.
Megan L.: If you want immediate temporary access, we can do a 2-hour jumpbox session — DM me and I can schedule it once infra approves.
Alex Tan: awesome, thank you. I'll paste the pubkey now and open the KMS request with the timeframe.
Samira K.: FYI: when you submit the request, set `env:staging`, `team:platform-infra`, and CC `jules@redwood.ai`. That avoids delays.
Alex Tan: done — submitted the request `REQ-3421`. Ping me if you need anything else. :slightly_smiling_face: 
Devon H.: saw the request, moving to infra queue. Should be approved today. Welcome aboard again! :tada:
